forum.title: Previous posts, badges, and profile history missing after New Community Platform migration
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello ​@AndyO ,

Thanks for reporting. I see your account was created on ‎2026-05-28 which falls under the migration timeline: [Now live: your new ST Community platform | Community](https://community.st.com/community-blog-161/now-live-your-new-st-community-platform-165935)

The need to re-enter the nicknames confirms that the account was migrated. Otherwise, the system redirects to a new account registration window.

Regarding the content, it was not migrated yet because it was created during the transition phase from May 22 to June 9.

If the topic is urgent, recreate the post. Otherwise, patience is appreciated until the remaining content is carried over.

Kind regards,

Lina
forum.content_text:
Hello,

After the migration to the new Community Platform, I appear to have lost access to my previous community account.

When I logged in today, I was unexpectedly asked to enter a nickname again. After doing so, I received the following email:

"Your account is successfully activated."

Since then:

\* My badges have disappeared.

\* My post history is empty.

\* Links to my previous topics redirect to the community home page.

One example is my topic:

VL53L1X returns 0x00 instead of 0xEA on PIC18F16Q41 hardware I2C

Thread ID: 901006

The topic still appears in Google search results, including the title, replies, and accepted solution, but clicking the result redirects to the community home page.

Could you please check whether my previous community account and content were properly migrated?

Thank you for your help.

Best regards,

AndyO
